rubrics.justification: Core grading is consistent with the provided 3AB description, but the response likely over-interprets image details by asserting central vacuoles/refractile bubbles and partial re-collapse without clear support.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior failed cycles, endometrium, diagnosis, and sperm factors well, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Overall logic is structured and mostly consistent, but the probability adjustment is partly driven by uncertain image findings and it labels two failed cycles as approaching RIF in a somewhat overstated way.

Much of the discussion is guideline-concordant, but recommendations such as aspirin, endometrial scratch, NK testing, broad thrombophilia workup, MTHFR testing, and routine ERA are not strongly supported for this scenario.
Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer technique, luteal support, and post-failure evaluation, though some proposed tests/interventions are not well-evidenced.
